content:
- name: Verify each source directory has a matching test directory
  run: |
    src_dir="src"
    if [ ! -d "$src_dir" ]; then
      echo "Source directory '$src_dir' not found"
      exit 1
    fi
    # Iterate over immediate subdirectories of src/
    for src_sub in "$src_dir"/*/; do
      [ -e "$src_sub" ] || continue  # skip if no subdirs exist
      subdir=$(basename "$src_sub")
      if [ ! -d "test/$subdir" ]; then
        echo "Missing test directory for source subdirectory: $subdir"
        exit 1
      fi
    done
    exit 0
